datasheet_id_and_revision: SBOS630D, December 2013, revised August 2016 (package addendum dated 8-Jan-2026)
citation_convention: pX = PDF page index; for PDF p1-p26 the printed page number equals the PDF index. Types: TYP, MIN, MAX (guaranteed; test level A = 100% tested at 25 C, B = characterization/simulation, C = typical only), CURVE (read from a typical-characteristic plot at 300 dpi, uncertainty stated), DERIVED (computed here from datasheet values), TEXT (statement in prose).
architecture: Integrated single-ended-input transimpedance amplifier with pseudo-differential output: TIA core with two internal feedback resistors (RF1, RF2, each with a parallel capacitor; RF2 switched in by CTRL, which also recompensates the core open-loop gain), class-A output stage, 25-ohm series resistor on OUT and on OUTN, reference buffer (5/9 VS) driving OUTN and (through an RC filter) the TIA non-inverting input, internal clamp + ESD diodes on IN, and an internal V-to-I test structure (Test_IN/Test_SD). Single supply 2.7-3.6 V. Photocurrent must flow into IN (photodiode cathode to positive bias); output only swings down from the reference. No DC / ambient-light cancellation. [p1 block diagram, p14 7.1, p15 7.3.1-7.3.3, p18 8.1, p21 8.2.2]

application_guidance: Target total source capacitance 1.5 pF incl. board; open planes under IN; minimise stray capacitance (p14, p23-p24)
Photodiode cathode to positive bias, anode to IN; Test_IN = +VS, Test_SD = GND in normal use (p19)
Signal chain example: OPA857 -> THS4541 (gain 5) -> ADC34J45; RG 374 ohm gives 798 ohm load; TIDA-00725 (p18-p19)
External RF || CF from IN to OUT lowers gain and extends bandwidth; 0.1 pF needed to remove peaking (p21-p22)
Bypass 10 nF + 100 nF within 0.25 inch; do not socket (p23-p24)
other_notes: Inconsistencies: 5 k bandwidth 125 MHz (EC p6) vs 130 MHz (p21); reference 1.83 V (p6, p15) vs 1.85 V (p18); Table 4 lists '500 kOhm' load (typo for 500 ohm); ESD diodes 'typically 30 mA continuous' (p16) vs 10 mA AMR input current (p5); revision history cites 'Figure 50' (layout is Figure 48); Figs 35-36 axis unit mV should be V.
Plots of Figs 2, 4, 17 extend to 105-125 C although the device is rated -40 to +85 C.
Bandwidth values are typical only (test level C).
